war_declared.text: The council has voted, and {my_faction} is now at war with {enemy_faction}. I did say patience had its limits, did I not?
War with {enemy_faction} was never my wish, only the council's necessity. Some of us kept the ledger on this one long ago.
{my_faction} goes to war with {enemy_faction}, carried by a comfortable margin. I shall not dwell on how comfortable.
Hostilities with {enemy_faction} are declared. Do keep your sword sharp and your gossip sharper, friends of {my_faction}.

peace_made.text: Terms with {faction} are signed and {my_faction} may breathe again. I suggested this quietly, months ago.
Peace with {faction} is agreed, though I note some lords have already forgotten who kept the talks alive at all.
A truce with {faction} now stands before the council. Do not mistake a truce for forgiveness, as I certainly have not.
{faction} and {my_faction} have made peace, and the ledger shows whose name is on the first line of the accord.

player_joined_my_faction.text: Welcome to {my_faction}, {player}. The council will want to hear your views before anyone else's, I am sure.
Welcome to {my_faction}, {player}. Do come and find me when the council next sits, as there is much to discuss.
You have sworn to {my_faction}, {player}. I shall reserve judgement on your sincerity until the first vote has passed.
{player} has joined {my_faction}. How fortunate for the council, and how very fortunate for you, {player}.

player_left_my_faction.text: {player} has left {my_faction} for {faction}. Loyalty is a fine thing to keep, and I shall keep a note of who lacked it.
You have gone to {faction}, {player}. I do not condemn it. I only remember it, as I remember everything.
{player} has chosen {faction} over {my_faction}. I wish them every comfort in their new hall, which I expect will be cold.
I will not pretend I am glad to see you go, {player}. Still, I hope {faction} rewards your judgement better than we did.

player_granted_fief.text: {fief} has been granted to {player}. A generous decision, though I did wonder whether the council had weighed the other petitions.
So {fief} went to you, {player}. Do enjoy the walls. I shall be watching how long the garrison remains loyal.
Congratulations on {fief}, {player}. I hope the rents are as generous as the vote was, though I would not count on it.
{player} now holds {fief}. Patronage is a curious thing, and I have been reading the council's accounts with great interest.

whisper_alliance_offer.text: {player}, {enemy_faction} grows bolder, and {rival} has been seen dining with their envoys. Shall we talk before the council sits?
Between us, {player}, I keep a list of what {rival} owes. An alliance against {enemy_faction} might settle a few accounts.
{player}, we have both counted {rival}'s votes. Shall we stand together against {enemy_faction}? Do think on it.
{enemy_faction} is a shared problem, {player}, and {rival} a shared inconvenience. I would welcome your thoughts on remedying both.

my_faction_took_fief.text: {fief} now belongs to {my_faction}, taken from {enemy_faction}. The council will hear the particulars, and they are flattering.
{my_faction} has taken {fief} from {enemy_faction}. I had hoped for a quieter afternoon, but I shall take the victory.
The banner of {my_faction} flies over {fief} tonight. {enemy_faction} may wish to reconsider its tax collectors.
{fief} has fallen to {my_faction}, and {enemy_faction} has lost a fine town through its own inattention.

player_took_my_fief.text: {player}, you have taken {fief} from me. I shall not forget the banner you raised over it, nor the wall you failed to guard.
{player} has seized {fief}, which was once mine to administer. I shall be sure the council remembers who held it before.
You have taken {fief}, {player}. Well played, though I would have done it with fewer trumpets.
{fief} changes hands to {player}. Such is the fortune of war, though the council may want a word on how it was lost.

encounter_alliance_yes.text: Yes, {player}, I accept. Against {enemy_faction} we stand together, and {rival} may find the vote far harder to win after this.
I accept your proposal, {player}, on the usual terms. Let us be seen together when {rival} is watching, which will be often.
Agreed, {player}. Our banners against {enemy_faction} will look splendid, and {rival} will certainly take notice of them.
You have my word, {player}. I shall write the terms in my ledger tonight, and I trust you will remember them as well as I do.

encounter_alliance_no.text: No, {player}. I have read your ledger of promises, and it is far too short for my liking. Good day to you.
I must decline, {player}. Your offer is generous, but I am bound by a prior understanding with {rival}, and that bond I keep.
Not this time, {player}, and I say it with genuine regret. The council has its rules, and I keep to them more than most.
No, {player}. Ask me again once the council has finished counting the votes it has already cast, and then we shall see.

ambient_chatter.text: The rain has turned the road to {town} into a bog again. Someone ought to raise the matter at council before the carts sink.
Has anyone heard what the reeve of {village} is charging for grain? I keep the figures, and they are not kind.
Lag again this morning, and I could not log a single petition. The council will hear about the servers, mark me.
A fine evening over {town}. Pity the lords there are still arguing about a bridge, as they have done since the Oath.
